channel.title: GO687 Travel – Italy Travel Tips
channel.description: Practical Italy travel guides from GO687 Travel

item.title: Colosseum and Vatican tickets: how to book
item.description: Colosseum and Vatican Museums tickets in 2026: official prices, which ticket to choose, when sales open, free days, ID rules and how to avoid fake sites and long queues.

item.title: Venice in 2 days: the perfect itinerary
item.description: Venice in 2 days: a day-by-day itinerary (St Mark's, Rialto, Murano, Burano, Dorsoduro), where to sleep, how to arrive by train or plane and what to book in advance.

item.title: Renting a car in Italy: what you need to know
item.description: Renting a car in Italy as a tourist: the documents you need (IDP), age and credit card rules, insurance, ZTL zones, motorway tolls, fuel and speed cameras.

item.title: Cinque Terre by train: card, tickets and tips
item.description: How to visit the Cinque Terre by train from La Spezia or Levanto: Cinque Terre Treno Card prices 2026, single tickets, timetables, trails and tips to avoid the crowds.

item.title: Fiumicino Airport to Rome city center: train, taxi or bus
item.description: How to get from Rome Fiumicino airport to the city center: Leonardo Express to Termini, the cheaper FL1 regional train, the €55 fixed taxi fare and airport buses.

item.title: Train strike in Italy: what travelers should do
item.description: Train strike in Italy? Guaranteed time bands and trains, refunds for Trenitalia and Italo, where to check strike dates and how to rebuild your travel day.

item.title: Rome, Florence and Venice in 7 days
item.description: A 7-day Italy itinerary for Rome, Florence and Venice by high-speed train: where to sleep, what to see each day, what to book in advance and the Venice access fee.

item.title: Trenitalia vs Italo: which train to book
item.description: Trenitalia or Italo? Routes, stations, classes, prices and tips to choose the right high-speed train in Italy — and when only a regional train will do.

item.title: How to validate a train ticket in Italy
item.description: Which Italian train tickets need validation, how to stamp a paper ticket, check-in for digital regional tickets, and what to do if you forgot — to avoid on-board fines.

item.title: Venice access fee: who pays and how to book
item.description: Venice access fee explained: €5 or €10, which days and hours, who is exempt (hotel guests, under 14), how to get the QR code and how to pay less.

item.title: ZTL in Italy: how to avoid fines when driving
item.description: What a ZTL is in Italy, how to read the gates, how fines reach rental cars months later, and how to drive to your hotel without a ticket.
